site_recommendation.material: 淡黄褐及灰褐砖面、深褐檐下；残顶暗灰，不把砖塔涂成新木塔或统一金色。
site_recommendation.lineDetail: Portrait 1024x1536. The SQUARE Shandao brick pagoda, present eleven-tier surviving form with corbelled brick eaves and arched openings. Preserve the broken flat/notched upper termination seen in the reference. Do NOT reconstruct the two lost original tiers or add a finial. Remove foliage and use the surviving repeated brick structure, not modern temple halls.
site_recommendation.lede: 层叠砖檐把方塔逐渐收紧，残缺塔顶仍保留着时间的痕迹。善导塔与香积寺的沿革相伴，现貌不按完整十三层复原。
facts: 年代 建塔与修缮年代有681、706两种文献解释；年表采用唐代约略定位。
形制 方形砖塔，现存十一层，层叠出檐；塔顶已有残损。
现貌 历代修护后的遗存，不补绘已消失的上部两层。

Make one complete BLACK INK contour drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF canvas. All blank surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white. Remove trees, tourists, vehicles, wires, incense burners, signs, sky and neighboring buildings. Preserve the source's identifying architecture; do not invent hidden buildings.

Landscape 1536×1024 unless specified portrait; subject fills approximately 82% of the useful axis. This is a WHITE-BACKGROUND original, not native transparent; a local script will prepare a transparent copy later.
